question: Which professionals have done at least three types of treatments? List the professional id and cell phone.
gold_query: SELECT T1.professional_id , T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*) >= 3
